title: Continuous-Time Quantum Walks based Graph Neural Network
abstract: arXiv:2608.20738v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are widely used on graph-structured data, but most suffer from two key weaknesses. First, message passing behaves as a low-pass filter under the homophily assumption, leading to poor performance on heterophilic graphs. Second, stacking layers drives node features toward constants, causing over-smoothing. Existing methods usually address these issues separately, while the few joint solutions rely largely on empirical heuristics, and many over-smoothing remedies sacrifice model expressiveness.   We propose \textbf{CTQW-GNN}, a GNN based on Continuous-Time Quantum Walks (CTQW), to address both issues with theoretical justification. Its design exploits two properties of the CTQW propagator $e^{-\mathrm{i}Ht}$. First, it is unitary and has eigenvalues on the unit circle, so no frequency component is damped, counteracting the low-pass bias. Second, unitarity preserves feature norms and prevents the Dirichlet energy

translated_title: 基于连续时间量子游走的图神经网络
translated_abstract: 图神经网络（GNNs）广泛用于图结构数据，但大多数存在两个关键弱点。首先，消息传递在同质性假设下表现为低通滤波器，导致在异质图上的性能不佳。其次，堆叠层会使节点特征趋向于常数，引起过度平滑问题。现有方法通常分别处理这些问题，而少数联合解决方案主要依赖经验启发式，且许多过度平滑的补救措施牺牲了模型表达能力。我们提出了CTQW-GNN，一种基于连续时间量子游走（CTQW）的GNN，以理论依据解决这两个问题。其设计利用了CTQW传播子$e^{-\mathrm{i}Ht}$的两个性质。首先，它是酉的，特征值在单位圆上，因此没有任何频率分量被衰减，从而抵消了低通偏差。其次，酉性保持特征范数，并防止狄利克雷能量（下降）。
tldr: 本文提出CTQW-GNN，利用连续时间量子游走的酉传播子同时解决图神经网络的低通滤波偏差和过度平滑问题，具有理论依据。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CTQW-GNN, which leverages the unitary propagator of continuous-time quantum walks to simultaneously address low-pass filtering bias and over-smoothing in GNNs with theoretical justification.
